newsitem.title: UK: Black, Baltic Sea oil exports up 216k bpd on week.
newsitem.headline: Black, Baltic Sea oil exports up 216k bpd on week.

text.p: Oil exports from Baltic and Black Sea terminals rose 216,107 barrels a day (bpd) to 1.6 million bpd in the second week of February from the previous week and were 560,153 bpd up from the same week last year, Petro-Logistics said on Wednesday.

The Geneva-based consultancy, tracking tanker movements, said crude exports from Baltic and Black Sea ports fell by 18,443 bpd on the week to 847,691 bpd. But they rose by 156,064 bpd over the same period last year.
Gas oil exports rose 187,761 bpd to 554,577 bpd in the week, representing a rise of 258,426 bpd over last year.
Heavy fuel exports rose 31,030 bpd to 194,767 bpd and were 109,236 bpd higher than last year.
Gasoline and jet exports combined totalled 52,025 bpd, up 25,890 bpd over the previous week and up 36,427 bpd from last year.
